description:
MUST HAVE JIVE experience 
 Base requirement: 6+ years of practical hands on experience work with Java developing large highly scalable web applications. Completed 2 major web projects. Understands how to leverage design patterns such a singleton, factory, composite. 3+years experience working with javascript frameworks. 3+ years experience writing effective Unit Tests leveraging Junit or TestNG frameworks. Agile Scrum experience a plus. Successful candidates will have: Engineering first-wants to write code; motivation to learn new tools (Agile, CI); always looking to simplify code cleanup; steps back to think through issues; multi-tier web stack experience.


 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 DURATION: 6+ Months Contract  
 
 INTERVIEW: Telephone / Skype
